points.statement: A shared backbone with heterogeneous expert modules balances commonality and specificity across tasks.
points.quote: LLaRS resolves the core contradiction between multi-task commonality and specificity by embedding heterogeneous expert modules into a shared backbone (46).

points.statement: Universal restoration priors come from the shared backbone, while routed experts learn task-specific strategies with limited overhead.
points.quote: The shared backbone captures universal image restoration priors, while the dynamically routed experts learn task-specific strategies without introducing prohibitive computational overhead.

points.statement: Heterogeneous inputs are padded to a fixed channel count before the backbone to share a common layout and parameters.
points.quote: Here CC is a fixed unified channel count: heterogeneous inputs are padded to CC before the backbone so batches share a common layout and parameters.

points.statement: A language-conditioned foundation model unifies multiple restoration and enhancement tasks under natural-language guidance.
points.quote: To this end, this paper presents LLaRS (see Fig. 1), a language-conditioned (8) foundation model that unifies eleven restoration and enhancement tasks under natural-language guidance.

points.statement: Users specify operations through text prompts, and the model routes input through task-appropriate processing pathways.
points.quote: Users specify the desired operation through intuitive text prompts such as remove the blur or enhance resolution, and the model routes the input through task-appropriate processing pathways.

points.statement: Heterogeneous sensor inputs with varying channels and spectral meanings are aligned into matched slots through regularized transport to ensure consistent feature semantics.
points.quote: First, heterogeneous sensor inputs with varying channel counts and spectral meanings are aligned into semantically matched slots via entropy-regularized optimal transport solved with Sinkhorn iterations (50; 11), ensuring consistent feature semantics across modalities.

points.statement: Complementary expert layers process spatial patterns, spectral fidelity, and global context to enable specialized yet coordinated transformations.
points.quote: Second, three complementary mixture-of-experts layers process spatial patterns, spectral fidelity, and global context, enabling specialized yet coordinated feature transformations.

points.statement: Dynamic weight adjustment at the step level stabilizes joint training across tasks with differing loss scales and convergence rates.
points.quote: Third, step-level dynamic weight adjustment stabilizes joint training across tasks with heterogeneous loss scales and convergence rates.

points.statement: A regularized transport aligns heterogeneous bands into matched slots, complementary expert layers route features by spatial, spectral, and global context, and dynamic weighting stabilizes joint training.
points.quote: LLaRS employs Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport to align heterogeneous bands into semantically matched slots, routes features through three complementary mixture-of-experts layers (convolutional experts for spatial patterns, channel-mixing experts for spectral fidelity, and attention experts with low-rank adapters for global context), and stabilizes joint training via step-level dynamic weight adjustment.
